supersedes_note: 0.1.0, 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 were never used for coding, unitizing or any derived event; schemas/codebook/v0.1.0.json, v0.2.0.json and v0.3.0.json are kept unchanged as records
scope: per-brief neighbourhood analysis (PRD v2.0, ADR-047): one brief's deep forensics (15-25 winners, 15-25 matched losers) are coded, double-coded and reported per field; no gate G1, no global library, no promotion rule

semver_policy.patch: wording, examples, clarifications; no coded value can change
semver_policy.minor: new enum value, field, module or core field; existing codes stay valid
semver_policy.major: enum value removed, renamed or redefined; or a derived-field threshold/window changes
semver_policy.before_1_0_0: before 1.0.0 a change that would otherwise be major bumps the minor version; it needs a changelog entry, and a dated amendment to any pre-registration that pins the old version stating what data had been seen
semver_policy.one_point_zero: no longer tied to the withdrawn M4 pilot G1 freeze (ADR-049.5, ADR-049.6); proposed: tag 1.0.0 after the M15 pilot report is verified (open issue)
semver_policy.per_brief_pin: a brief pins the codebook version before its outcome sort; a definition change applied to a brief after its outcome sort makes the affected findings exploratory

burst_series.detection_and_segmentation: raw star-history daily net counts (TM-33; ADR-032.3, ADR-035), fetched per repo (ADR-047.8, PRD R19.5), on endpoint days in star_history_day_tz (OM §1.2), for every case
burst_series.onset_refinement: hourly stargazerCount snapshots of the repo, only where they cover the whole 48-hour detection window; never used for detection, end, merging or quiet. None exist today: the pre-re-scope watch-list cache (repo_count_snapshot, ADR-032.1) was dropped by migration 0014 (ADR-047.6, ADR-051.1), and the ADR-048.2 launch-mode schedule (every 3 h on launch day) does not cover every hour. Onsets are therefore day-precision unless launch mode (ADR-048.2, ADR-049.1, M14) collects hourly snapshots
burst_series.filtered_variants: not used to define burst or quiet units (unknown for most windows, ADR-032.3); where a filtered variant is eligible (OM §1.2, §4) for the whole case window a re-segmentation may be reported as exploratory
burst_series.gh_archive: never used for onsets or segmentation (ADR-047.8)
burst_series.completeness_check: incomplete when the connector reports an error or a missing page for any week the case window needs, or when the all-time sum of returned days differs from stargazers_count fetched in the same run by more than 1 %; days of incomplete weeks are coverage gaps (CB §3.2; formerly pilot amendment 1 A2)

event_parameters.burst_detection_rule: velocity-v0 on endpoint days (OM §2.1; parameters schemas/analysis-params/v1.0.0.json block burst; code pigtail.analysis.bursts): day d fires when n(d-1) + n(d) >= 100 and z >= 3, baseline = the 30 endpoint days before d-1 converted to 48-hour sums, sigma with the sqrt(mean) floor of ADR-027 item 3; a burst starts at the first firing day not already inside a burst
event_parameters.burst_refire_rule: ADR-052: a burst's end is its first calm day (after the burst). A firing whose 48-hour window starts on or before the previous burst's last day (d-1 <= last burst day) is ignored: neither a new burst nor a merge. A firing whose window starts on the first calm day or later counts normally. After an open burst nothing fires
event_parameters.burst_onset_rule: OM §2.1 exactly: where hourly count snapshots of the repo cover the 48-hour window (endpoint days d-1 and d), onset = earliest hour with net gain > mu_h + 3*sqrt(mu_h) (mu_h + 1 if mu_h == 0), with mu_h = mu_d / 24 (mu_d = mean stars per endpoint day over the 30-day detection baseline), else window start, precision hour; otherwise the same rule on endpoint days d-1, d with mu_d, onset = start of the first qualifying endpoint day, else start of d-1, precision day. The burst containing the case's recorded T_burst onset takes that recorded onset and precision.
event_parameters.burst_end_rule: start of first run of 3 consecutive endpoint days (OM §1.2) each with raw star-history stars <= mu_d + 3*sqrt(mu_d) (mu_d + 1 if mu_d == 0), mu_d = mean stars per endpoint day over the burst's detection baseline
event_parameters.burst_shape_rule: sudden_fast_decay: peak <= 48h after onset and < 50% of peak within 7d; gradual_build: peak > 7d after onset; else mixed (on endpoint days: peak day index 0 or 1 from the onset day; a daily count < 50% of the peak within day indices <= 7; gradual_build when the peak day index > 7)

inputs_frozen_at_T: README at the last commit before T
the evidence record that fixed T_launch, if anchor_type is launch
novelty_claim.present_requires: first-party quoted span (<= 300 chars) with an explicit novelty marker, from the inputs
novelty_claim.absent_requires: every listed input captured and none contains a qualifying span
not_novelty: release or version newness (relaunch language, CB §3.6)
performance or cost superlatives without a novelty claim (benchmark_claim)
generic marketing adjectives (modern, next-generation, powerful, simple)

spread_graph.account_nodes_hold: ADR-022 until LQ-8 answered; lifting requires an ADR plus CB-10 and CB-14

also_requires: both endpoint evidence hash-valid and locators verified
source timestamp precedes target timestamp given precision
no privacy hold on either endpoint

spread_graph.replied_edge_rule: only when replier is the project node or the reply links the repo/site; otherwise reply_count on the item
spread_graph.reach_storage: band only; exact count discarded at ingest (CB-10)

public_figure_rule.status_natural_persons: inactive until LQ-7 answered and ADR
public_figure_rule.organisations_and_publications: may be named in private UI only (LQ-7 default)
criteria_all_required: coded activity within that public role (FADP Art. 31(2)(f))
role documented in a cleared-source snapshot
not a matched-loser maintainer nor personal-account repo owner among any brief's cases

day_precision_onset.t0: start of the onset endpoint day (OM §2.1)
day_precision_onset.proximal_window: [t0 - 48h, end of the onset endpoint day + 6h]
day_precision_onset.time_offset_h: measured from t0; time_precision of the onset recorded on every candidate

distal_window.requires: quoted lag rationale or explicit citation by a proximal item

trigger_attribution.high_confidence_requires: hour-precision onset and hour-precision candidate timestamp
trigger_attribution.interpretation: association only; causal claims only via R8.1 event studies

pattern.scope: one brief version; no global library

loser_contrast_rules.prevalence: present / (present + absent); unknown excluded from numerator and denominator

reporting_minimums.note: v0 design choice; a brief may set stricter minimums before its outcome sort, never looser after it

requires: estimator (not plain TWFE with staggered triggers)

pattern.status: none (no candidate/promoted status; ADR-047.3, PRD R20.2)

activation_any: primary or secondary category in [ai-apps-agents, ml-infra]
description/topics/README hero at T names an ML model, LLM or agent framework as the product core

shared_case_fields.novelty_claim: same value as the case-level novelty_claim (case_fields, CB §5.1); coded once per case, not again by the module

activation_any: paid or hosted offering by the same project with evidence <= T+90d
README at T mainly Chinese or has a Chinese README variant
V2EX mention in the case window
chinese_ecosystem.coverage_note: V2EX only, off by default until H2 Q8 (ADR-010); Juejin, Zhihu, Bilibili are GAP; Gitee not audited; default channel-attribution result is 'insufficient evidence'

activation_any: repo at T ships a command-line entry point
owner is a GitHub organisation identified as company or foundation by a first-party artifact
README at T states maintenance or sponsorship by an organisation
timeline has a relaunch or pivot event
repo age at T > 365 days with evidence of a prior launch

category_taxonomy.source: ADR-017; table and assignment method in CB §9 (moved from OM v1 §3.1)
category_taxonomy.role: case descriptor (module activation, neighbourhood description, brief field boundaries); not a normalization cell or stratum (ADR-049.8)

reliability_reporting.rule: Krippendorff's alpha per field, per brief, on pass A and B values after citation validation and before adjudication; shown for every coded field (R7.5, PRD §9.2)
reliability_reporting.low_reliability_action: label findings resting on the field 'low reliability'; never drop (ADR-047.7)
reliability_reporting.human_sample: optional (WORK_ORDER H3); LLM-human alpha reported per field the same way
reliability_reporting.ordinal_unknown_handling: unknown treated as missing; companion nominal alpha on known/unknown; label applies if either is below 0.70
reliability_reporting.multi_valued_handling: split into one binary nominal field per value
reliability_reporting.degenerate_companion: 1.0 (degenerate: no unknowns) when neither coder used unknown or not_applicable
reliability_reporting.no_gate: no category-change quota, attempt limit or codebook freeze tied to alpha

core_fields_note: coded and double-coded in every brief's deep forensics; C11b retired (id not reused)

coding_rules.on_citation_failure: drop value; set unknown with reason citation_failed
coding_rules.outcome_masking: coders never see a case's role (winner, matched loser), pair membership, outcome values or percentiles, or the brief's success definition; no exception (the role reading is derived after coding)

privacy_rules_cb_11.P1: no GDPR Art. 9 / FADP Art. 5(c) attributes; no gender, age, nationality or location of individuals
privacy_rules_cb_11.P2: no scoring or ranking of natural persons; reach in bands only
privacy_rules_cb_11.P5: public-figure rule inactive for natural persons until LQ-7 + ADR
privacy_rules_cb_11.P6: no private individual, matched loser or personal-account repo named in any output; patterns refer to cases by case_id
privacy_rules_cb_11.P7: coded values from person-level evidence inherit person_level_24m
privacy_rules_cb_11.P8: no coded values, spans, snapshots, pseudonyms or user briefs in git

retired_in_0_3_0.mechanism_card: replaced by pattern (ADR-047.3; PRD F9 retired, F20)
retired_in_0_3_0.promotion_deciding: flag retired with the promotion rule
retired_in_0_3_0.reliability_gate.g1_alpha_min: G1 retired (ADR-047.7); 0.70 is now the low-reliability label cut
retired_in_0_3_0.modules.relaunch_pivot.prior_case_outcom: global classes retired (ADR-049.12); replaced by prior_case_role

changelog.change: (a) burst/quiet derivation moved from starscout_filtered stargazers-API series to raw star-history endpoint days (ADR-032, ADR-035), with hourly watch-list snapshots only for onset precision per OM §2.1; burst end on endpoint days; day-precision onsets get a defined trigger window and cannot reach high trigger_confidence; §2.1/§2.3 examples updated. (b) new case-level non-core fields novelty_claim and novelty_kind (MC-09); ai_hype.novelty_claim now shares the case value. No enum value in g1_category_change_denominator added, removed or renamed. Minor bump: (b) adds fields; (a) changes a derived-field input, which before 1.0.0 bumps minor (semver_policy.before_1_0_0). No coding, unitizing or derived event ever used 0.1.0; no outcome data seen. Re-code: none (nothing coded).

Re-scope to per-brief neighbourhood analysis (ADR-047, ADR-049). (a) G1 removed: per-field, per-brief alpha with 'low reliability' (< 0.70) and 'reliability not assessed' labels; category-change rule and its denominator dropped (ADR-049.6). (b) mechanism_card replaced by pattern (PRD F20): n per side, loser contrast, counterexamples, per-field reliability, sensitivity flags; status, promotion rule, applicable_strata, saturation_trend removed. (c) card confidence levels retired (ADR-049.7); trigger_confidence kept. (d) mechanism_support -> pattern_support; C11a renamed; C11b direction retired, replaced by a role-based reading derived after coding. (e) no global cells or strata (ADR-049.8): category is a descriptor; relaunch_pivot.prior_case_outcome_class -> prior_case_role. (f) burst derivation unchanged on per-repo raw star-history; watch-list onset refinement only from cached snapshots; completeness check restated. Privacy rules unchanged apart from P6/P8 wording. Minor bump (before 1.0.0, would-be-major changes bump minor). No coding ever used any version; no outcome data seen. Re-code: none.

Patch (ADR-051, ADR-052). (a) burst_refire_rule added: a firing whose 48-hour window starts on or before the previous burst's last day (d-1 <= last burst day) is ignored; one starting on the first calm day or later counts normally (ADR-052), so a single-day spike is no longer always merged into a multi_peak burst; restores the stated intent of 'first firing day not already inside a burst'. (b) burst_detection_rule cites schemas/analysis-params/v1.0.0.json and pigtail.analysis.bursts instead of the retired thresholds JSON and the removed src/pigtail/capture/detection_v1.py (ADR-051.3). (c) onset_refinement: no hourly cache survives migration 0014 (ADR-051.1), so onsets are day-precision unless launch mode collects hourly snapshots (ADR-048.2, ADR-049.1). No enum, field, threshold or window changed; analysis-params stays 1.0.0. No coding ever used any version; no outcome data seen. Re-code: none.
